messages:
mira: Quick heads-up — PR #2874 ready but I'm holding merge. CI flagged a couple of things: struct JSON tags are mixed (some `userId`, some `user_id`) and gofmt changed an import order. Small, but want consensus before I push the fix. PTAL? https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2874

jordan: glanced — looks mechanical. My vote: normalize tags to snake_case for JSON payloads (we've been using that for the public API). Also keep `gofmt`/`gci` ordering standard (stdlib, blank line, internal, external).

sam: +1 for snake_case. If it's just tag changes + formatting, do the fix and squash. No lint exceptions please. If you want, I can do a quick pass after you push.

mira: ok pushing a tiny commit in a sec. Current struct snapshot that triggered the lint:

```go
type CreateUserRequest struct {
  UserID   string `json:"userId"`
  Email    string `json:"email"`
  FullName string `json:"fullName,omitempty"`
}
```

I changed to: `json:"user_id"`, `json:"full_name,omitempty"` etc. Also ran `gofmt` and `gci fmt` locally.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Build failed — gofmt / import-order check failed on 1 file.
```
cmd: gofmt -l ./pkg/api
out: pkg/api/handlers.go
```

jordan: thanks for the sample. If you push one commit that normalizes tags + runs `gofmt`/`gci`, we can merge once CI is green. If the commit touches many files, consider splitting format-only into its own commit so the review is easier.

sam: Mira — paste the diff here or link the commit and I'll take a quick look. If it's tiny, I can approve after green.

mira: pushed: `fix(json): normalize tags to snake_case and fmt` — https://github.com/redwood/inference/commit/abcdef1 Re-requesting review @sam @jordan

jordan: LGTM modulo one tiny import-order nit in `pkg/api/handlers.go` (stdlib and external libs were swapped). If you want, I can push a follow-up, otherwise just include in the squash.

sam: CI is green now. I took a look at the diff — tags look consistent and the formatting-only changes are isolated. Approved. :rocket:

mira: thanks! merging during the 10:00-11:00 merge window in ~5m. I'll watch for any rollout issues. :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks — nice and tidy.

mira: merged — closing the PR. If anyone sees a regression in the API contract tests, ping me and I'll revert immediately.
